title: Billing
description: Manage your plan, credits, and invoices.

popover.subheader: Recharge instantly or set up automatic funding.

monthly.activeDescription: ${amount} will be added to your balance every month automatically.
monthly.intro: Set a fixed monthly amount that will be automatically added to your balance every month. No more manual recharges.
monthly.activeSubtitle: Credits are added automatically every month.
monthly.cancelConfirm: Cancel monthly funding? Credits already added stay in your balance.
monthly.consent: I understand my card will be charged monthly.
monthly.consentHint: Credits are added after each successful payment. Cancel anytime.
monthly.setupSubtitle: Add {amount} to your balance every month
monthly.creditsNote: Credits are added after each successful monthly payment.
monthly.setupDoneBody: We've added your first {amount} and will top up automatically every month.

autoReload.activeDescription: When your balance drops below ${threshold}, ${amount} will be charged and added automatically.
autoReload.intro: Never run out of credit. Set a minimum balance threshold and we'll automatically reload your account.
autoReload.summary: Your card will be charged ${amount} now and saved for future automatic reloads when your balance drops below ${threshold}.
autoReload.rule: When your balance drops below {threshold}, we add {amount}.
autoReload.consent: I authorize Ringee to charge my saved payment method when my balance drops below the selected threshold.
autoReload.enableError: We couldn't turn on auto-reload. Please try again.
autoReload.requiresMethod: Auto-reload requires a saved payment method.

footer.cardSafety: Card details never touch Ringee servers

checkout.title: Secure checkout
checkout.subtitle: Add {amount} to your Ringee balance
checkout.errorBody: Something went wrong preparing your payment. Please try again.
checkout.missingKeyBody: Stripe isn't set up for this environment yet. Add your publishable key to enable checkout.
checkout.creditsNote: Credits are added after payment confirmation.
checkout.emailHint: Your Stripe receipt is sent here — edit it if you want invoices elsewhere.

saved.title: Fast recharge
saved.subtitle: Recharge {amount} with your saved card
saved.chargeNote: You'll be charged using your saved payment method.

consent.save: Save this payment method for faster future top-ups.
consent.hint: Recharge next time with one click.
